verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਇਕ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g pa(n)ch sabadh ik sabadh milaae|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh while immersing his meditational faculty in the Word listens to the Word alone even through the five types of sounds (created through many instruments).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਲਖ ਸਬਦ ਲਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਅਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh lakh sabadh lakh bhaakhiaa bhaau subhaau alaae|

en.bdb: Considering the ragas and nadas only as the medium, the Gurmukh discusses and  recites with love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੀ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਵਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh braham dhiaan dhun jaanai ja(n)trree ja(n)tr vajaae|

en.bdb: Only the Gurmukhs understand the melody of the knowledge of the supreme reality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa veechaar kai usatat ni(n)dhaa varaj rahaae|

en.bdb: The Sikhs ponder on the words of the Ineffable, and abstain from praise and blame.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar miThaa bolan man parachaae|

en.bdb: Allowing the Guru's instruction to enter their hearts they speak politely and thus comfort one another.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਗੁੜ ਕੀੜਿਆਂ ਰਖੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਲੁਕਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jai milan guR keeRiaa(n) rakhai rakhanahaar lukaae|

en.bdb: The Sikhs' virtues cannot be concealed.  As a man may hide molasses, but ants will discover it.
As the  sugarcane gives juice when pressed in a mill, so must a Sikh suffer while conferring favours on others.
